# Actor models

No third-party model files are bundled. The twin's people, cats and dogs are articulated figures built in code
(`app/js/twin/actors.js`, part of this project): ellipsoids and tapered limbs with vertex colours and a procedural fur
shader. Permissively licensed glTF models (for example the CC0 Quaternius packs) can be added here later, with a
GLTFLoader vendored next to three.js; record each file's source, author and licence in this file.
